text: CRAN release: 2025-10-15 lookup_icd_codes(), get_icd_codes(), icd_compact_to_full(), is_icd(). Introduces unified comorbidities() interface covering Charlson (Deyo, Quan 2005/2011, Glasheen), Elixhauser (original, Quan 2005, AHRQ 2017-2025), Pediatric Complex Chronic Conditions (v2.0/2.1/3.0/3.1). Bundles curated ICD dictionaries alongside example datasets (mdcr, mdcr_longitudinal) reproducible testing demonstrations.
